United Airlines just reached a major milestone: Starlink Wi-Fi is now available on 50% of its DAILY flights

United's official live tracker now shows:

• 674 aircraft equipped with Starlink
• 352 regional aircraft
• 315 narrowbody aircraft
• 7 widebody aircraft
• 50% of daily flights now have Starlink

And the rollout is accelerating

United is targeting 61% of daily flights by the end of 2026, with its entire fleet expected to be equipped by the end of 2027

Starlink is transforming in-flight connectivity, and millions more passengers are getting access to high-speed internet in the sky
